programs.title: Emergency
programs.desc: At The Royal Melbourne Hospital, Dr Jonathan Papson discovers devastating news for an injured driver. Drs Andrew Wallace and Emma West fear a chef, who fell down an escalator, has brain injuries. Otto wins hearts and cuddles in the office.

programs.title: Emergency
programs.desc: At The Royal Melbourne Hospital, Dr Jonathan Papson is impressed with the pain tolerance of a mechanic who was crushed under a two-tonne ute, after the jack gave way. Dr Andrew Wallace shows off his ‘fugly’ shoes and colourful socks.

programs.title: Paramedics
programs.desc: Emergency responders face real-life crises, including accidents, medical emergencies, and rescue operations. The show follows paramedics, police, and firefighters as they handle high-pressure situations. Through real footage and firsthand accounts, it reveals the intensity and urgency of emergency services.
